assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), vastus lateralis, Kallisto GRCh38 (S2.8.p1)
design: randomised cross-over: 10 resistance-trained females, normal sleep (NS) vs sleep restriction (SR), resistance exercise sessions on days 3,5,7,9; RNA-seq on PRE-exercise biopsies of day 3 and day 9 only (S2.2.p2, S2.7.p1, S3.2.p2)
repeated_measure_unit: participant (each woman sampled in both conditions and both days)
sample_inclusion: all RNA sequencing samples (S2.8.p1); 10 participants x 2 conditions x 2 days = 40 planned, 38 deposited
primary_estimand: exercise-training effect: pre-exercise day 9 (48 h after the 3rd of three REx sessions on days 3,5,7) vs pre-exercise day 3 (before any session in that condition), within NS and within SR (S3.2.p7); secondary: SR vs NS at day 3 and at day 9 (S3.2.p2)
planned_contrasts: NS day 9 vs NS day 3 (exercise training under normal sleep; paper: 2962 DEGs, up 128 / down 2834, S3.2.p7)
SR day 9 vs SR day 3 (exercise training under sleep restriction; paper: 2219 DEGs, up 102 / down 2117, S3.2.p7)
SR vs NS at day 3 (sleep restriction, no exercise; paper: 1 DEG, GGNBP2, S3.2.p2)
SR vs NS at day 9 (sleep restriction with equal training; paper: 0 DEGs, S3.2.p2)
normalization_filter: keep genes with at least 10 reads on average -> 15,543 transcripts (S2.8.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2 ("DESeq R package v1.40.2"; design formula not stated, pairing on participant not stated) (S2.8.p1)
paper_results: exercise contrasts ~3000 DEGs reported 'FDR < 0.05' in S3.2.p7 / S3.3.p2; sleep contrasts 1 and 0 DEGs; GSEA (fgsea, Reactome, log2FC ranking): oxidative metabolism up with training (S3.2.p8)
